name: karate

source.origin: W. W. Zachary, An information flow model for conflict and fission in small groups, J. Anthropological Research 33 (1977); the 78-edge version shipped as networkx.karate_club_graph() and igraph.Graph.Famous('Zachary')
source.terms: Published scientific data, redistributed by NetworkX (BSD) and igraph (GPL); 78 edges.

ids: rank of the original id among the ids that appear in the file
semantics: Everygraph defaults: self-loops dropped and counted, repeated pairs analysed once; triangles and core numbers on the undirected projection
